post.description: Find solicitations by keyword (description; with `match: any` also item description, bid number and alternate id), organization (agency), buyer, NIGP class, type code, status, UNSPSC category or opening-date window; pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid and a `blanket_number` to get_blanket. Use list_open_bids instead for the site's curated list of currently open solicitations. At least one criterion is required; a legitimate zero-row answer sets `total_count` to 0.

bid_number.description: Bid solicitation number or prefix, e.g. `BD-27-1060-ITD00-ITD00-133949` or `BD-27-1060` (the form's Bid # field).

buyer.description: Buyer id as the site uses it (e.g. `AUDREY.BANKS`) or the buyer's name as listed (`Last, First`); a unique fragment is accepted.

category_code.description: UNSPSC segment of the form's Category dropdown: the two-digit code, e.g. `43` (Information Technology Broadcasting and Telecommunications) or `00` (Grants), or a unique fragment of its name.

cursor.description: Row offset of the page to return (a multiple of 25), as given by the previous answer's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page. The same criteria must be passed again; the site's session is re-established on every call. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

keyword.description: Free text matched against the solicitation description (the form's Description field). With `match: any` it is also applied to the item description, bid number and alternate id, as the site's quick search does.

match.description:
`all` (default): every filled criterion must match (the form's default). `any`: the site's Any/OR switch; the keyword is copied into the description, item description, bid number and alternate id fields, and a row matches when ANY filled criterion matches - so combining `any` with `status` or `type_code` returns every bid with that status or type, not the intersection. Use `any` for keyword-only quick searches and `all` when combining filters.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "any"]; default "all".

nigp_class.description: NIGP class code of the form's NIGP Class dropdown, e.g. `43-23`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

opening_date_from.description: Bid opening date lower bound as the form takes it, MM/DD/YYYY. Pattern: ^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])/[0-9]{4}$.

opening_date_to.description: Bid opening date upper bound, MM/DD/YYYY. Pattern: ^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])/[0-9]{4}$.

organization.description: Organization (agency) code as the site uses it, e.g. `1060`, or its name as listed, e.g. `Executive Office of Technology Services and Security`; a unique case-insensitive fragment of the name is accepted, an ambiguous one is rejected with candidates.

status.description:
Status code: 2BA Approved, 2BCL Closed, 2BE Evaluated, 2BIA Intent To Award, 2BO Opened, 2BPO Bid to PO, 2BS Sent (open for responses).

Provider reference: allowed values ["2BA", "2BCL", "2BE", "2BIA", "2BO", "2BPO", "2BS"].

type_code.description:
Solicitation type: NS Non-Statewide Solicitation, SH Historical Solicitation, SS Statewide Solicitation.

Provider reference: allowed values ["NS", "SH", "SS"].
